entry.title: New: Resolution 641 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — now tracked
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO THE KELI‘IPIO-KUAMO‘O FOUNDATION, INC., FOR EXPENSES RELATING TO A KĪPAEPAE CEREMONY HONORING THE PRESERVATION OF HONOLULU LANDING

Transfers $1,250 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 5)

View on the council site
